lore.quark.abacus: Use this on a block and it'll count the distance between the block you're looking at and the one you clicked, up to 48 blocks.
lore.quark.ambience_discs: Ambience Discs can be gotten when a Skeleton kills a Spider. Unlike Music Discs, these loop infinitely.
lore.quark.ancient_fruit: Falls from Ashen Trees when they're chopped down. Gives you a small amount of XP when eaten.
lore.quark.blackstone_furnace: If the block under this furnace produces Soul Fire when lit, the furnace will too.
lore.quark.chorus_weeds: Uncommon spawns in the barrens of the outer end. Will randomly teleport and reproduce over time or if forced via trampling, bone meal, or adjacent water. May also spawn Endermites when trampled.
lore.quark.chute: Drops any items fed into it by a Hopper/Dropper into the world directly below.
lore.quark.diamond_heart: The core of a Stoneling. Using the Heart on raw stone will construct a new body out of it, and make it friendly to you.
lore.quark.glass_item_frame: Hides the frame when an item is put inside to show only the item. Has custom behavior for Banners and Shields, and can sit flush with a Sign that's on the floor. Can also be right clicked through to open any inventory behind it.
lore.quark.glow_lichen_growth: Found in the rare Glimmering Weald biome deep underground.
lore.quark.glow_shroom: Found in the rare Glimmering Weald biome deep underground. Bone Meal can be used to create a large variant.
lore.quark.glowing_glass_item_frame: Glowing version of a Glass Item Frame - has all the same properties.
lore.quark.gold_button: Emits a very short, 2 redstone tick, pulse.
lore.quark.golden_apple_crate: Very valuable. Can be used as a Beacon base.
lore.quark.grate: Animals that aren't leashed will not walk on this, and items will fall through.
lore.quark.gravisand: Only falls when given a redstone signal, taking adjacent ones along with it. If it can't fall, it'll float upwards. Emits a comparator signal of 15.
lore.quark.hollow_logs: Can be crawled into by sneaking while walking towards the hollow side, can also be climbed when you're inside.
lore.quark.iron_button: Emits a very long, 5 second, pulse.
lore.quark.iron_rod: Will break any blocks in front of it when pushed with a piston.
lore.quark.item_frame_dyeing: Can be dyed the same way you'd dye leather armor.
lore.quark.jasper: Can be found in big clusters in mesas and deserts.
lore.quark.lavender_blossom_sapling: Can be found in temperate rainforests.
lore.quark.limestone: Can be found in big clusters in swamps and oceans.
lore.quark.magnet: Can push and pull any blocks made of Copper or Iron when powered, depending on the side. If multiple magnets are moving the same block, the biggest force will win. A magnet's force on a block is the redstone signal it's given minus the distance to the block. Hoppers moved with a Magnet will drop one item in front for each block moved. If the item is a seed, it'll try to plant it instead. Stonecutters moved with a Magnet will try to break the block above them.
lore.quark.music_disc_endermosh: Can be found in End City chests.
lore.quark.myalite: Can be found in big clusters in the outer end highlands. It reacts to an invisible field in the world, changing color depending on where it's placed with the field's intensity.
lore.quark.parrot_eggs: Throw to create a baby parrot. Feed a parrot many Beetroot Seeds until it loves you, and then it'll lay one after 10 minutes.
lore.quark.pathfinders_quill: Can be used to find the biome inscribed in it. Trade for it from Cartographers or Wandering Traders.
lore.quark.permafrost: Can be found towards the top of Frozen Peaks.
lore.quark.pickarang: It's a Pickaxe Boomerang! Can be thrown and will mine anything it hits and bring you the drops back. It can also be enchanted for better performance.
lore.quark.pipe: Moves items put in with a Hopper/Dropper. Items going into a full container will turn back. Disableable with a Redstone signal, and readable with a Comparator. Pipes with over 16 items will break.
lore.quark.posts: Can be placed in any axis. Chains and Lanterns can connect to this block.
lore.quark.pottable_stuff: Can now be added to a Flower Pot.
lore.quark.ravager_hide: Will drop from Ravagers in Raids.
lore.quark.red_blossom_sapling: Can be found in autumnal areas.
lore.quark.redstone_randomizer: Randomly repeats the given signal either left or right.
lore.quark.rope: Must be placed on a ceiling and can be climbed. Can be right clicked onto other Rope to drop down, or pull up while sneaking. Can move the block that's on the edge.
lore.quark.rotating_bundles: Scrolling while hovering over a bundle will rotate the items inside.
lore.quark.seed_pouch: Can hold a bunch of any one seed or sapling, simply right click them in and out. The pouch can also automatically pick up seeds if you're holding it, or place 3x3 areas by using it on a block.
lore.quark.shale: Can be found in big clusters in cold biomes.
lore.quark.shulker_box_right_click: Items can be right clicked onto the Shulker Box much like you would for a Bundle.
lore.quark.sign_editing: Signs can be edited by right clicking on them.
lore.quark.skull_pikes: When placed over a fence, simple monsters that wander close by will be scared and run away.
lore.quark.slime_in_a_bucket: Starts jumping in it's bucket when you're inside a slime chunk.
lore.quark.smithing_template_rune: Combine in a Smithing Table with an enchanted item to change its shine color. This is purely visual.
lore.quark.snow_golem_player_heads: Having a Witch kill a named Snow Golem will drop the Player Head matching the golem's name.
lore.quark.soul_bead: Drops from Wraiths in Soul Sand Valleys. Will fly towards the nearest Nether Fortress when used.
lore.quark.soul_fire_candles: When placed on any block that can produce Soul Fire when lit, it'll do so as well.
lore.quark.stools: Can be sat on, and stay sat on when moved by a piston. Placing a block on top will change the stool to a table.
lore.quark.sturdy_stone: Can not be moved by pistons.
lore.quark.torch_arrow: Will try to place a torch wherever it lands.
lore.quark.trowel: Randomly places a block from your hotbar when used. You can have the same block in multiple slots to increase its odds.
lore.quark.wool_muffling: Can be used to silence minecarts if placed under the rail.
quark.jei.hint.lavender_blossom_sapling: Can be found in temperate rainforests.
quark.jei.hint.red_blossom_sapling: Can be found in autumnal areas.
